requirements: Practice Software Testing - Toolshop web application at https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/. Test the complete customer journey and authentication flows. Authentication: login with customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01 (customer role, Jane Doe); admin login with admin@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01; registration of a new customer; forgot password flow; account lock after repeated failed login attempts. Product catalog: paginated product overview grid with images, names and prices; search (3-40 chars); category filter with hierarchical parent/child checkboxes; brand filter; combined filters; sorting (Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Price High-Low, Price Low-High); price range slider ($1-$100 default, $200 max); discount display with strikethrough original price; out of stock indicator. Product detail: image, name, description, price, category and brand badges; add to cart with quantity; add to favorites (customer). Cart: increase/decrease quantity, delete item. Checkout: 5 steps - cart, sign-in, billing address (with postcode lookup), payment method, delivery details with order summary and confirmation. Invoices: customer sees invoices overview and detail. Contact form: subject categories, message with file upload. Account profile: update profile, change password, favorites list.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Customer login (customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01) succeeds and shows the customer's account area with invoices and favorites. 2) Invalid credentials show an error; 5 failed attempts lock the account. 3) Registration creates a new customer able to log in. 4) Product grid paginates, search filters results, category/brand checkboxes filter, sorting reorders, price slider narrows range. 5) Product detail shows name, price, description and Add To Cart; quantity can be increased/decreased in cart; items can be deleted. 6) Checkout completes through sign-in, billing address, payment (Bank Transfer / Cash on Delivery / Credit Card with card fields), and shows 'Thanks for your order!' confirmation. 7) Invoices overview lists orders with invoice number and status; detail shows product lines and totals. 8) Contact form validates required fields and accepts a message submission. 9) Favorites: adding a product marks it and it appears in the account favorites list.
application_context: Practice Software Testing (Toolshop) - Angular 20 + Bootstrap 5 SPA backed by a Laravel 12 REST API (api.practicesoftwaretesting.com) with MariaDB, Redis cache, JWT auth. Angular Material components: data-test attributes throughout (data-test=page-title, search-query, search-button, category-filter / parent-category / child-category checkboxes, brand-filter, product-price, checkout buttons). Pages: /auth/login (email, password, data-test=login-submit), /auth/register, /auth/forgot-password, / (product grid), /product/{id}, /checkout (step cart -> signIn -> billing address -> payment -> delivery), /account (invoices, favorites, profile), /contact. Known accounts: admin@practicesoftwaretesting.com/welcome01 (admin), customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com/welcome01 (Jane Doe), customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com/welcome01 (Jack Howe), customer3@practicesoftwaretesting.com/pass123 (Bob Smith). Product categories: Hand Tools, Power Tools, combined categories (e.g. Sanding, Grinding) with child categories; brands include Flex, Bosch, Makita.
